description: This file implements package registry synchronization logic, including reading installed package data from a YAML registry file, syncing packages with persistent storage, and watching for registry file changes using fsnotify in a Go project.

classes.name: InstallationRegistry
classes.description: Represents the installed packages registry loaded from installed.yaml, containing a map of package names to InstalledPackage instances.

classes.name: InstalledPackage
classes.description: Details of an installed package, including name, version, description, installation path, source info, and runtime status.

methods.name: SyncPackagesFromRegistry
methods.description: Reads installed.yaml, loads each package, and syncs it to storage if not already present.

methods.name: StartPackageRegistryWatcher
methods.description: Watches installed.yaml for changes and automatically triggers synchronization with storage when updates occur.
